label: Perfection of GOD_4 from its gift of esse, with universal-source preexistence
meaning: Sibling of ea6317cf (perfectFromGodCause) with universal-source preexistence in place of q.4 a.2 preexistence 64498e7e, which that proof applies only with GOD_4 as the cause. Let g be GOD_4 and x in act in r. If x is g, done. Otherwise GOD_4 causes the being of every other being (86d02b69), so g is a universal cause of being and causes x's being; universal-source preexistence gives that g is in act in r. The conclusion 78b7c124 is in the frame's mode-open act (IN_ACT_4). The route through this sibling needs no nonuniversal transfer. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
